A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the all-order KBB summation of core polarization diagrams with the low-momentum interaction is a very useful approach to the construction of shell model effective interactions.

the all-order core-polarization effects are not important for the effective interactions of light nuclei, and the results obtained by the second-order perturbation are sufficient for the sd-shell effective-interaction calculations.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the KBB approach is a viable and simple method for calculating the effective interactions in the low-momentum shell model.
the KBB approach can be applied to all-order core polarization using low-momentum interactions.
the all-order KBB summation approach can be used to calculate effective interactions with all orders of core polarization for low-momentum interactions.
